attribution: LastTime is a client frame metric. Temporary owned method wrappers and probe-driven entry may attribute work to the probe slot; zero per-package lychee readings do not mean zero target CPU. Bracketed Tick times include all currently scheduled motion jobs and completion work. Frame timings include the entire application and waiting.
